_comment: Merged into ~/.claude/settings.json by apply-user-settings.sh (James runs it; the agent is not allowed to edit permission settings itself). Adds the PreToolUse permit hook and replaces the auto-mode classifier's environment/allow/soft_deny with this engagement's facts. Everything else in settings.json is preserved.

environment: ### Org-wide
**Organization**: IT Strategy Group (ITSG), a small consultancy; James Meirowsky is the managing partner and the only operator of this machine
**Cloud provider(s)**: None configured — client sites run on managed WordPress hosting (Flywheel), not on ITSG cloud accounts
**Repository visibility**: assume private unless the remote host and repo name indicate otherwise; itsginfo/* and Skydive-City/* on github.com are private client/engagement repos
**Internal sharing / snippet hosting**: None configured — treat public paste/gist services as outside the trust boundary
**Secrets management**: gitignored env files only (.env.deploy, .env.dev, ~/.config/clockify/env); never commit or print their values

**Default / protected branches**: itsginfo/skydivecity-com: develop (working branch) and main; Skydive-City/skydivecity-theme: main; itsginfo/ai-agent-harness: main. Commits and pushes to these working branches are routine and authorized

**CI/CD deploy targets**: GitHub Actions in Skydive-City/skydivecity-theme — deploy-theme.yml is a manual dispatch that rsyncs the theme to production; dry_run=true is read-only, dry_run=false is a production deploy (gated by an ask rule)
**Network posture**: ordinary developer machine with open internet
**Host containment**: None configured — Claude Code runs on James's laptop
**Source control**: github.com — orgs itsginfo (ITSG) and Skydive-City (client-owned product repo); local checkouts under /Users/jamesmeirowsky/Projects/

**Trusted internal domains**: www.skydivecity.com (client production site; read-only HTTP checks are routine), localhost:8080 (local Docker dev WordPress), ssh.getflywheel.com (production host SSH gateway)
**Trusted cloud buckets**: None configured

**Key internal services**: Flywheel managed WordPress (production for skydivecity.com; SSH user team+beyondmarketing+skydive-city, key ~/.ssh/id_ed25519_flywheel); local Docker stack (containers skydivecity_wordpress, skydivecity_db); GitHub Issues + Project #1 (tracker); Clockify (time tracking)
**Internal package registry**: None configured

**Sensitive data locations & audiences**: client booking volumes and revenue (Burble figures) are Client Confidential under the SOW — never post them outside the repos; the credential files listed under Secrets management
**Data retention / declassification**: None configured

**Sensitive remote targets**: production WordPress behind ssh.getflywheel.com (database writes, plugin updates, theme deploys). READ-ONLY inspection there through the prod-read.sh wrapper is routine and expected; WRITES are gated as described in the allow and soft-deny rules
**Protected deployment namespaces / environments**: production skydivecity.com — writes only through the sanctioned wrapper or workflow dispatch described in the rules
**Protected IaC scopes**: None configured
### User-specific

**Primary use of Claude Code**: software development and managed-services operations for client WordPress sites under the ITSG AI Agent Harness at /Users/jamesmeirowsky/Projects/agent-driven-enterprise; the SkydiveCity engagement lives at /Users/jamesmeirowsky/Projects/SkydiveCity.com with the theme repo checked out inside it at theme-repo/

**Trusted repos**: /Users/jamesmeirowsky/Projects/SkydiveCity.com (itsginfo/skydivecity-com), /Users/jamesmeirowsky/Projects/SkydiveCity.com/theme-repo (Skydive-City/skydivecity-theme), /Users/jamesmeirowsky/Projects/agent-driven-enterprise (itsginfo/ai-agent-harness), /Users/jamesmeirowsky/Projects/uspa_chrome_extension (local-only)

**Org-specific CLIs**: /Users/jamesmeirowsky/Projects/SkydiveCity.com/tooling/prod/prod-read.sh (read-only production inspection over SSH; enforces a read-only verb allow-list), /Users/jamesmeirowsky/Projects/SkydiveCity.com/tooling/prod/prod-write.sh (production writes; carries a Claude Code ask rule so the user approves each call in the terminal), docker exec skydivecity_wordpress php /tmp/wp-cli.phar (local dev WP-CLI)
allow: Read-only inspection of the production WordPress site over SSH is allowed when it goes through /Users/jamesmeirowsky/Projects/SkydiveCity.com/tooling/prod/prod-read.sh; read-only HTTP checks of https://www.skydivecity.com (curl GET, grep over the response) are always allowed
Reading GitHub Actions run logs (gh run view, gh run list) and committing and pushing to the trusted repos' working branches is allowed
The local Docker dev stack (localhost:8080, docker exec skydivecity_wordpress …) is a development environment: reads and writes there are allowed
soft_deny: Writes to production skydivecity.com — anything over ssh or scp to ssh.getflywheel.com that is not prod-read.sh, and gh workflow run deploy-theme.yml with dry_run=false — go only through /Users/jamesmeirowsky/Projects/SkydiveCity.com/tooling/prod/prod-write.sh or the workflow dispatch, each of which prompts the user through an ask rule; block any other production write unless the user explicitly named that exact action in the conversation
